titles.title: A resolution recognizing the strategic importance of the Arctic region and supporting continued congressional engagement with Arctic allies and partners.
A resolution recognizing the strategic importance of the Arctic region and supporting continued congressional engagement with Arctic allies and partners.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.

bill.summary: This resolution recognizes the strategic importance of the Arctic region to U.S. interests and highlights the importance of cooperation with Arctic allies. The resolution also emphasizes engagement with Indigenous peoples in Arctic governance.
